summary: Skratch tests team setups for the Season 9 Crown Contest Ice Fortress against the Ice Guardian boss. The boss gains permanent Defense Up and Attack Up whenever an enemy unit dies, making summoners like Lincos risky to run. Aura and Dauntless teams struggled around 700M to 900M damage due to suboptimal gear and boss buff mechanics. In contrast, a Poison/Toxin squad featuring Child of Chaos, Serpentemis, Sacredeia, Sleight, and Twitch scored an easy 2.38 billion damage, which could reach even higher with Lothair.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: New exclusive support who boosts HP and provides massive team sustain, making her the premier Aura choice if available.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Provides HP boosts, shields, and buffs, outperforming alternatives like Anselmo and Rena.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: His summoned accompanist feeds the boss permanent Defense Up and Attack Up stacks whenever it dies.

heroes.name: Shahla
heroes.note: Viable replacement for Lincos to avoid feeding the boss death triggers.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Achieved around 907M damage, beating out alternatives like Selva and Acilia.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Brought for cleansing boss debuffs but resulted in lower team damage (around 696M) compared to Tharivol.

heroes.name: Acilia
heroes.note: Added debuff immunity and healing, but tanked total Dauntless team damage down to 515M.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Top poison damage dealer who could add roughly 500M more damage over Twitch if properly geared.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Serves as an effective substitute for Lothair in a 2.38B damage Poison setup.

teams.note: Top performing squad scoring 2.384B damage; Child of Chaos provides adequate healing, while Lothair can replace Twitch for higher scores.
Aura setup scoring ~894M damage; Anneliesis is timed to strip the boss's Defense Up buff.
Best Dauntless variant tested, scoring ~907M damage without dedicated cleansers.

tips: Avoid bringing summoner heroes against the Ice Guardian, as summoned minion deaths grant the boss permanent Defense Up and Attack Up.
If using Anneliesis against the Ice Guardian, tune her ultimate skill timing to roughly 5 seconds to dispel the boss's early Defense Up buff.
Poison/Toxin compositions heavily outperform Dauntless and Aura on the Ice Fortress when gear quality is lacking.
